newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland may pass banking law before elections-paper.
newsitem.headline: Poland may pass banking law before elections-paper.

text.p: Poland's parliament may pass the new banking law before parliamentary polls in September, the head of the Sejm's budget committee told the Dziennik Prawa i Gospodarki (PG) daily.
"This Sejm may still pass the banking law. If this does not happen, these regulations may come into force in two to three years and do harm to Polish banks," Wieslawa Ziolkowska said.

Poland's Finance Minister said last month that passing the bill, designed to enhance security of Poland's banking system and bring it in line with EU standards, before general elections on September 21 was one of his priorities.

The bill, which passed its first reading in the Sejm, would also provide for an independent Banking Supervision Commission that would oversee the sector and guard against unfair competition between banks.
